name: Cybot
description: Cybot was a third-degree protocol droid bounty hunter that was active during the years 5 and 10 ABY. Cybot had gold-colored plating as well as yellow and orange photoreceptors. The droid stood 1.7 meters tall and wielded weapons such as a Bryar pistol, an E-11 blaster rifle, a carbonite gun, and thermal detonators.
